q1_issues.issue: "ground" is a descriptive, non-classifying modifier on a plural, so it must distribute over the members via (Implication (PartOf $x sk_feathers_1) (Member $x ground)); (Member sk_feathers_1 ground) instead predicates groundness of the group-as-object, the reading the plural rules explicitly bar.

notes: "ward back" is correctly kept as one phrasal-verb symbol with no genus, the episodic bare-plural subject correctly mints a group witness, and the wraith is Theme (displaced, not altered). Whether "ward back" counts as distributive enough to also require a per-member rule on sk_keepers_1 is genuinely unclear.
